name: notes-editor
description: 云笔记 Milkdown WYSIWYG 编辑器岛，esbuild 打包为 static/notes-editor.js；样式在手写的 static/css/notes-editor.css

scripts.copy-katex: rm -rf ../../static/vendor/katex && mkdir -p ../../static/vendor/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css ../../static/vendor/katex/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/*.woff2 ../../static/vendor/katex/fonts/
